title: Two problems at once

complaints.says: I can't hear the hi-hat mic at all.
And my acoustic guitar has gone silent.

hints: These are two separate faults. Take them one at a time.
cause: 48V phantom power was off for the hi-hat condenser mic, and the leader's tuner pedal was left engaged.
lesson: With several complaints, fix one, confirm it, then move to the next. Condensers need 48V; tuner pedals mute while engaged.
